source.rationale: issue #35. `message_id + modality + media_ordinal` is the CRM's idempotency key (uq_contact_media_usage_idempotency on respond_io_id/message_id/modality/media_ordinal), so a constant-empty message_id collapses it to (contact, modality, ordinal) and a SECOND voice note from the same contact is served the FIRST note's cached transcript. The id is NOT at the A level (`item.messageId`) - the redis envelope carries it at message.message.message.messageId, which is what `$('tf-message').first().json.message.messageId` reads everywhere else in this spine (the chat_histories logger and Call 'sub-human-intervention' both write THAT value as their `message_id`). respond.io's own `messageId` is preferred over `channelMessageId` because the CRM field is documented as "Respond.io messageId" (app/schemas/external/media.py) and because keeping the same id space is what lets a media-ledger row be joined back to chat_histories; channelMessageId is the fallback for a channel that sends no respond.io id.
